run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the maximum sum subarray after removing one element from an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple input arrays to verify maximum sum subarray results
review_f_gold: review f_gold which uses forward and backward Kadane passes to compute max subarray sum
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a single pass approach instead of forward and backward arrays
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which computes the maximum contiguous subarray sum when one element is removed
